jobs.title: Limited-Term Instructor of Kinesiology and Health
jobs.salary: 10 month salary commensurate with qualifications and experience.
jobs.summary: Limited-Term Instructors are full-time faculty hired on a semester-to-semester basis. After the first semester, the position is renewable for a maximum of three semesters. The primary responsibilities of this position include teaching a full instructional load of foundational Kinesiology and Health courses across multiple modalities. Courses include Anatomy and Physiology in Kinesiology and Health, Medical Terminology, Introduction to Kinesiology and Health, and other foundational offerings within the discipline. Faculty are expected to provide meaningful academic support, foster an engaging learning environment, and collaborate effectively with colleagues to promote student success.
